subject: Host-API Penetration Test Access and Secure Transfer Options
messages:
From: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@nimbushealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: latest PT report for Hosted API + preferred secure transfer

Hi Logan,

We are completing our SIG and CAIQ review and need the latest penetration test report that covers Redwood's Hosted API endpoints (public tenant). We want to confirm the scope covers authentication flows, token handling, and file upload endpoints. Can you confirm scope and share the most recent report?

For transfer, our security team prefers either:
- a time-limited S3 presigned URL (48h) OR
- an encrypted archive (PGP) delivered via a secure portal.

Also: does Redwood redact customer PII (example request bodies) in the full report, or do you provide a redacted executive summary plus an encrypted full report?

We can provide an IP allowlist if you need stable addresses to allow.

Thanks,
Jordan Hale
Security Engineer, Nimbus Health
security@nimbushealth.com

[attachments: Nimbus_SIG_partial.xlsx]
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest PT report for Hosted API + preferred secure transfer

Jordan —

Thanks for the note and the context. Quick answers up front:
- Scope: the March 2027 engagement covers Hosted API (public endpoints), token lifecycle (issue/refresh/revoke), upload endpoints used by our API, and our gateway/authN layer. It excludes Dedicated/Private customer-managed infrastructure.
- Redaction: we publish an executive summary (PDF) with high-level findings and a fully redacted results matrix. The full technical report can be delivered encrypted (GPG) to vetted contacts on the NDA/portal list.

Transfer options we can support:
1) S3 presigned GET link (48h expiry) for the encrypted archive (recommended for speed)
2) Secure SFTP access for a 7-day window (IP allowlist supported)
3) Customer portal link protected by one-time token + optional IP restriction

If you want the full encrypted package via S3, we can:
- create a GPG-encrypted tarball (pt-full-report-2027-03.enc.gpg) and provide a presigned URL
- post the executive PDF (PT-executive-summary-2027-03.pdf) unencrypted to the same link set for immediate review

Next steps from our side: we need a primary point of contact for encryption key exchange (PGP fingerprint) or confirm S3 is acceptable and provide the list of IPs (if selecting SFTP) so we can open a temporary ACL.

Attaching a short metadata file with the engagement scope and redaction policy: redwood-pt-metadata-2027.txt

— Logan Wright
Enterprise Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

From: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@nimbushealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest PT report for Hosted API + preferred secure transfer

Logan,

Thanks — S3 presigned is fine. We'll accept the executive summary unencrypted; please keep the full report encrypted.

Requesting the following from you:
- 48-hour presigned link to the encrypted archive
- GPG fingerprint for the decryption key (or, if you prefer, we can provide our public key to encrypt on your side)
- Confirmation that report redacts customer request bodies and personal identifiers; if any customer-owned data is in-scope, please indicate the vendor/customer IDs and we will coordinate redaction requests

We will not provide PGP keys via email. We can paste the public key into our vendor portal or use an OOB channel (Okta Verify/Enterprise Slack).

Also: could you include a short remediation status table (high/medium/low) with current fix status and ETA for open items? That helps our internal triage.

– Jordan
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@nimbushealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest PT report for Hosted API + preferred secure transfer

Hi Jordan —

Looping in remediation summary as requested. Short answers first:
- Redaction: the executive summary excludes customer request bodies and strips UUIDs/keys. The technical appendix contains records that are redacted per our policy; anything that cannot be redacted without losing repro steps is encrypted in the full report.
- Remediation: we include a table in the executive PDF that lists open findings per severity plus the current status. Below is a quick paste from that table (current as of 2027-03-22):

High:
- Insecure token cache invalidation — mitigated (deploy 2027-03-18)

Medium:
- File upload content-type validation — fix in staging, rollout scheduled 2027-04-02
- Rate-limit bypass under specific concurrency — monitoring enabled, mitigation planned for 2027-04-09

Low:
- Deprecated header handling — completed 2027-03-05

We will attach: PT-executive-summary-2027-03.pdf (unlocked), and prepare pt-full-report-2027-03.enc.gpg. We can either encrypt with your public key if you upload it to the vendor portal or we can provide our encrypted package and give you the passphrase via a separate channel (1Password/phone).

Preferred transfer: presigned S3 link to the encrypted file + separate OOB exchange of the passphrase (your preference).

— Olga Petrov
Security Manager, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

[attachments: PT-executive-summary-2027-03.pdf]

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest PT report for Hosted API + preferred secure transfer

Jordan —

We uploaded the encrypted archive and executive summary. Deliverables below:
- Executive summary (PDF): https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-secure/pt/2027-03/PT-executive-summary-2027-03.pdf (expires 2027-03-24 16:45 PDT)
- Encrypted full report (GPG): https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-secure/pt/2027-03/pt-full-report-2027-03.enc.gpg (expires 2027-03-24 16:45 PDT)

We will not send passphrases over email. Please provide one of the following for key exchange:
- upload your public key to the Nimbus vendor portal (preferred) OR
- confirm a secure Slack DM channel or 1Password share and we will deliver the passphrase there

HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/tickets/98765 (notes and remediation table attached)

If you want us to enable temporary SFTP instead (IP allowlist), reply with the list of IPs and the window (we can open for 7 days).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through the findings.

— Logan Wright
Enterprise Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
